title_en: On Rruga E Kavajes, in front of Delijorgjit, 2+1 apartment for sale, newly invested!!!
description_en: On Rruga e Kavaje, in front of Delijorgjit, 2+1 apartment for sale, newly invested and with a perfect location!!! The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​95 m² and a net area of ​​85 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room together with the dining and cooking area, the matrimonial room with dedicated toilet, the children's room, the balcony and the central toilet. Orientation from the West makes it light during most of the day. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment. The property has full mortgage documentation.
